mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 71 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Verona Community Park. We are under a new moon tonight, and the temperature will dip to a low of 65 degrees with no rain predicted.
The City of Verona has announced that road construction begins August 18 on Highway M, while the Senior Center is currently seeking dedicated volunteers to help with their essential services.
There is a lot going on today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we have live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local safety, on August 5, police arrested a man on Whalen Road for a probation violation after he attempted to flee officers.
You can enjoy the delicious Devil's Food Cake flavor of the day until closing time at 10 PM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
